fields.sample: Zika virus NS1 suppresses VE-cadherin via hsa-miR-29b-3p/DNMT3b/MMP-9 pathway in human brain microvascular endothelial cells.

license.observed_site: "HMDD is free only for academic usage. For commercial usage, please Contact Dr. Qinghua Cui..." -- no formal CC badge/link displayed on the live site itself

paper_vs_reality.observed: 1,896 unique values in the miRNA column overall (hsa- + virus- prefixes combined; consistent with 1,817 + 79 = 1,896)
2,379 unique values in the disease column (small drift consistent with continuous post-publication updates; Last-Modified 2023-07-11 vs. paper acceptance 2023-08-19)

22 distinct 'code' values found in alldata_v4.txt, grouping cleanly into the 8 stated categories (circulation[6 codes]/genetics[5]/target[3]/tissue[3]/exosome/epigenetics/virus_miRNA/other/therapeutic target)

paper_vs_reality.claim: Data Availability: online/open access at http://www.cuilab.cn/hmdd, Download page
paper_vs_reality.observed: Confirmed -- homepage HTML lists direct static file hrefs under /static/hmdd3/data/, including alldata_v4.txt and alldata_v4.xlsx, no login required

Site displays plain-text 'free only for academic usage' notice rather than a CC BY-NC badge/link -- non-commercial restriction confirmed on both, but presentation differs (MISMATCH in form, not substance)

risks: No public API -- bulk TSV is the only ingestion path; no live-update crawl possible.
Disease names are free text, not IDs -- no DOID/MONDO/MeSH code column present in this bulk file, so cross-referencing to mydisease.info requires future string-normalization work, not done here.
Non-commercial license restriction should be flagged to downstream API consumers, consistent with other NAR plugins carrying the same restriction (chemprob, molbic, persade, ttd).
